messages:
maria: heads up — planning a quick edge circuit swap today, shifting 15% traffic from edge-pool-b -> edge-pool-c. Target start 15:00 PT, change window 15:00-15:30. Need router pin/unpin and LB drain plan. anyone object?

deploy-bot: scheduled traffic-shift job id=1729991234 service=router-edge from=edge-pool-b to=edge-pool-c percent=15 start_ts=1729995600 duration_s=1800

ken: +1. can we warmup the pool for 5m before shifting? avoids cold caches.

maria: yes — warmup 14:55-15:00. i'll pin router-v2024-07-12-rc3 to edge-pool-c during warmup.

anika: preflighted healthchecks just now: 200/200, qps stable, cache-hit steady. looks good from infra side. cc @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: i'll watch latency & 5xx. alert thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 > 250ms for 3m => trigger edge-swap runbook and rollback. i'm on pager.

tim: suggest ramp strategy: 5% -> wait 5m -> 10% -> wait 5m -> 15%. rollback immediately if triggers hit.

maria: plan: warmup -> pin -> 5% canary -> monitor 5m -> 10% -> monitor 5m -> 15% finalize. rollback conditions noted.

deploy-bot: running preflight checks: kernel_modules=ok, certs=valid, drain_script=found, router_conf_hash=abc123 -> OK

router-ops: FYI the session-affinity header tweak on rc3 may cause a small cache-miss burst. expect a brief tail-latency bump during first minute after traffic shifts.

maria: good catch. we'll keep the first canary low and monitor tail. @tim please stage rollback commands now.

tim: staged rollback snippet in runbook: `routerctl traffic set --pool edge-pool-b --percent 100` then `routerctl drain --pool edge-pool-c --timeout 120` — ready to run if needed.

ken: i've saved the exact commands in /runbooks/edge-swap-1729991234.md and added a safety confirmation step.

anika: pinning dashboards: edge/slo, edge/latency-tail, edge/errors. will keep graph retention pinned to this run for 30m.

deploy-bot: warmup complete. starting shift in 5 minutes (t-300s).

maria: starting 5% now.

sre-oncall: monitoring — p95 180ms, 5xx 0.02% (ok). no alerts.

router-ops: seeing tiny cache miss spike ~+2% miss rate, tail up ~30ms. expected.

maria: moving to 10% now.

sre-oncall: p95 210ms, 5xx 0.03%. still within thresholds.

deploy-bot: traffic shift step complete: 10% -> 15% scheduled in 5m.

maria: proceeding to 15% on schedule.

sre-oncall: p95 back to 175ms, 5xx stable. all good.

anika: marking this run as successful in dashboard and notes. i'll stash release note: "edge pool swap — partial 15% shift for warm routing tests; no regressions observed."

maria: great. finalizing and unpinning rc3 after 15:30 unless anyone needs extended observation.

ken: no objections. thanks all.

maria: closing thread — if any late regressions file runbook ticket and we'll follow up. :thumbsup:
